outcome: A land can be played only with priority, an empty stack, in own main phase, and once per turn by default.
A face-down creature turns face up at any time its controller has priority, without using the stack.
A player ends a continuous effect or stops a delayed trigger by a special action whenever they have priority, without the stack.
A player may ignore a static ability's effect for a duration by a special action, without the stack.
Circling Vultures can be discarded whenever its owner could cast an instant.
A card with suspend can be exiled with suspend counters only when it could begin to be cast.
A companion can be moved to hand for {3} only in own main phase with empty stack and once per game.
A card with foretell can be exiled face down for {2} only during its controller's turn with priority.

note: Planechase is a casual variant; collection plays standard two-player games.
Conspiracy Draft is a draft variant; not a standard game.

outcome: A card with plot can be exiled only during its owner's turn with priority and an empty stack.
A locked half can be unlocked by paying its unlock cost only in a main phase of own turn with empty stack.
After a special action its taker receives priority again.
